subject.title: fix: cancel Android link preview calls

question: Should this PR wait for real Android behavior proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate?
rationale: The source, dependency, test, and CI evidence support the fix shape, but the external PR proof gate remains mock-only for a user-visible Android runtime path.

options.title: Require Android proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted Android device/emulator run, runtime logs, terminal live output, or recording shows slow link-preview cancellation completing promptly.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the missing real-behavior proof after exact-head Android validation is refreshed and green.

recommendation.title: Require Android proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted Android device/emulator run, runtime logs, terminal live output, or recording shows slow link-preview cancellation completing promptly.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, owns recent Android link-preview history, and authored the maintainer follow-up commits on this PR.
